summary: Complete single-file web application for multi-project financial tracking. Features: 4-tab navigation (Dashboard, Input Transaksi, Laporan, Pengaturan), localStorage data persistence with seed data, Chart.js charts (donut + bar trend), jsPDF export, SheetJS Excel export, full CRUD for projects/transactions/categories, audit log, backup/restore, Rupiah currency auto-formatting, dark mode glassmorphism premium design, mobile responsive.
